tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill, and the divider, on `surface-inverse`.
tokens.retire: Phase 1 (library parity): its component moves to the prototype design.

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: The lighter backdrop behind a dialog, a form dialog and a window, where the shadow lifts the dialog rather than the dim. A peek, a sheet, the palette and an alert keep `scrim`.
tokens.retire: Phase 1 (library parity): its component moves to the prototype design.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, keycaps and select triggers: a flat control with a faint 1px drop in light and none in dark. Dark is a transparent shadow rather than `none`, so it composes with `shadow-focus`.
tokens.retire: Phase 1 (library parity): its component moves to the prototype design.

tokens.name: shadow-primary
tokens.usage: The primary button: flat, with a faint accent drop in light and none in dark. Dark is a transparent shadow rather than `none`, so it composes with `shadow-focus`.
tokens.retire: Phase 1 (library parity): its component moves to the prototype design.

tokens.name: shadow-pinned-edge
tokens.usage: The edge the table's last pinned column casts over the columns scrolling under it, only while the table is scrolled sideways.
tokens.retire: Phase 4 (shell and navigation), or the phase that ports its screen.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px of surface, then 2px of focus-ring, so it reads on a blue button too (spec 0071).
tokens.retire: Phase 1: components move to the prototype outline ring (border-width-focus, 2px offset).

tokens.name: shadow-focus-inset
tokens.usage: The focus ring on rows, tabs and menu items, drawn inside the edge (spec 0071).
tokens.retire: Phase 1: components move to the prototype outline ring.
